Currently, this workspace is a **brand-new, clean project**—no application code or files have been created yet beyond the initial environment setup.

### How this project and environment work:

1. **Automatic Persistence & Git**: Everything we build or edit in your workspace is automatically saved and tracked with Git in the background.
2. **Live Preview**: When we create web pages or applications, you can view the live site here:
   👉 **[Open Live Preview](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/902266ae-5270-49fd-98c7-3a89a30dbf49/df7ae08c9d7c26fe5e8a39fa/)**  
   *(Updates appear automatically a few seconds after changes are saved.)*
3. **GitHub Sync**: If you'd like to connect this project to GitHub, tap the **GitHub mark** at the top of the chat window—your entire project history will sync over.
4. **Development Capabilities**: The environment has modern runtimes ready to use (including Node.js v22 and Python 3.11), allowing us to build frontends, static websites, full-stack apps, or backend scripts.

---

### What would you like to build?
Let me know what you have in mind (e.g., a web application, portfolio, dashboard, or tool), or if you were expecting a specific template or codebase to start with!
I guess I can’t build an iPhone app I can use huh?

**You actually can build an app you can use directly on your iPhone!**

Here is how you can do it right now, depending on what you're looking for:

---

### 1. Build a Progressive Web App (PWA) — *Works Immediately on Your iPhone*
This is the easiest and fastest way:
- We can build a mobile-first app designed specifically for iOS (touch gestures, iOS styling, local storage, offline support).
- You open your **[Live Preview Link](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/902266ae-5270-49fd-98c7-3a89a30dbf49/df7ae08c9d7c26fe5e8a39fa/)** in **Safari** on your iPhone.
- Tap the **Share** button (the square with the arrow pointing up) and select **"Add to Home Screen"**.
- It installs directly on your home screen with a custom app icon, launches full-screen with no browser address bar, and feels just like a native app.

---

### 2. Native App (Swift / SwiftUI or React Native)
If you want a native binary for the **Apple App Store**:
- We can write the complete **Swift / SwiftUI** or **React Native / Expo** code here.
- Because compiling iOS binaries (`.ipa`) requires Apple's Xcode (macOS), you can tap the **GitHub mark** at the top of the chat to sync the project to your GitHub, and then open it in Xcode on a Mac or build it using cloud build services (like Expo EAS or GitHub Actions).

---

### What kind of app do you want to build?
Tell me what app idea you have (e.g., a habit tracker, to-do list, workout log, budget tracker, game, or utility), and we can start building it as an installable iPhone web app right now!
Unfortunately I only have a iPhone, iPad Pro, and a steam deck. Lol

That setup is actually **more than enough**—no Mac or PC needed at all!

Here is why your iPhone and iPad Pro are perfect for this:

1. **Install directly without the App Store**:
   - We build a mobile-first web app right here in this chat.
   - You open your **[Live Preview Link](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/902266ae-5270-49fd-98c7-3a89a30dbf49/df7ae08c9d7c26fe5e8a39fa/)** in **Safari** on your iPhone or iPad Pro.
   - Tap **Share** ➡️ **"Add to Home Screen"**.
   - It gets its own home screen icon and opens in standalone full-screen mode (no URL bar, no browser buttons) with support for touch gestures, dark mode, audio/camera, and offline storage.
2. **Works across your devices**:
   - It will run on your **iPhone**, scale beautifully to your **iPad Pro**, and even run in desktop mode on your **Steam Deck**.
3. *(Optional iPad note)*: If you ever do want native Swift code without a Mac, Apple's free **Swift Playgrounds** app on your iPad Pro can actually build and run native iPad/iPhone apps directly on device!

---

### What app have you been wishing existed?
Give me an idea—even a rough or crazy one—and I'll build an interactive prototype for you to test on your iPhone right now!
